messages.subject: for loop produce parcial resultes
parts:
hello,
I'm trying to run this for loop (probably not very efficiently) :

for (i in sp_names){
sp.data=subset(spm1,species==as.character(i))
head(sp.data)
agg=aggregate(sp.data,list(sp.data$month),length)
agg=agg[,-3]
data.frame(agg)
colnames(agg)<-c("month","freq")
x=as.factor(agg$month)
month<-factor(x, levels = c("Dec a","Jan","Feb", "Mar","Apr", "May", "Jun","Jul", "Aug" ,"Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec b","Jan b","Feb b"),
            labels = c("Dec a","Jan","Feb", "Mar","Apr", "May", "Jun","Jul", "Aug" ,"Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec b","Jan b","Feb b"))
plot(month,agg$freq, main=i)
}

for some reason this loop produces plots only for some of the sp_names.
the funny (or not so funny) thing is that yesterday the same loop produced different plots for different sp_names.

when i try to produce a single plot everything works just fine :

sp.data=subset(spm1,species==as.character("Siganus.rivulatus"))
head(sp.data)
agg=aggregate(sp.data,list(sp.data$month),length)
agg=agg[,-3]
data.frame(agg)
colnames(agg)<-c("month","freq")
x=as.factor(agg$month)
month<-factor(x, levels = c("Dec a","Jan","Feb", "Mar","Apr", "May", "Jun","Jul", "Aug" ,"Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec b","Jan b","Feb b"),
              labels = c("Dec a","Jan","Feb", "Mar","Apr", "May", "Jun","Jul", "Aug" ,"Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec b","Jan b","Feb b"))

messages.subject: Re: [Israel RUG] for loop produce parcial resultes
parts:
**
I guess you use R-Studio and I guess you use the arrows to navigate between the plots.
R-studio saves only the last 30 plots, as you can see in this simple example:
for (i in 1:35)
  plot(i)

**
My suggestion would be to use the pdf() function.
You can use either one of the following examples:

1) creates single file each plot in a different page.
pdf ("file_name.pdf" )
for (){
.
.
}
dev.off()

2) creates many files, each file with a single plot.
for ( ){
pdf( paste( file_name,".pdf",sep ="" ) )
.
.
.
dev.off()
}
